implemented: Extended exact-project source grammar for literal facility electrical demand, activity-scoped fuel availability, voltage/phase, load profile, temporary-power procurement status, and utility interconnection status.
Claims retain exact quote, activity where applicable, as-of date basis, and existing accepted evidence ID/hash/version binding. Parser and pursuit policy versions were incremented.
Facility demand is shown separately from activity load and facility scale; it never mutates qualification or computes a temporary-power gap.

Fuel, voltage, and load profile each have independent resolvers. Combined suitability resolves only when all three are supported by current cited claims; conflicts and missing values remain unresolved.
Facility demand, procurement, and utility obstacles have explicit research categories, query routes, and card fields. Existing source-backed phase claims remain the milestone path.

Current retained examples remain bounded: Edged's 196 MW stays reported facility scale, Boston voltage remains an electrical constraint, and unsupported retained facility demand, fuel, and load profile remain unknown.
